title: Two Routes to Interoceptive Prioritisation: Dissociating Likelihood Precision and Preference Reweighting in Active Inference
title_zh: 内感受优先处理的两种路径：主动推理中可能性精度与偏好重权重的解离

paragraphs.en: An embodied agent must prioritise among competing bodily needs. In active inference, it can respond to an urgent need by increasing the precision of information about that need or by increasing its preference for outcomes that relieve it. We compare these two interventions, separately and together, in a foraging gridworld with three lethal needs, and ask how each changes survival, perception and the body model the agent learns. Precision sharpens interoceptive posteriors and improves survival. Preference reweighting keeps bodily states further from their lethal boundaries and changes the states from which the agent learns, so its learned model covers fewer need levels, with lower quality across all levels but slightly higher quality on the levels it visits. An experiment on 72 further layouts does not establish the predicted preference benefit on difficult layouts, but both interventions improve average survival there and their interaction is positive. Survival alone therefore gives an incomplete account of how a model prioritises needs and learns about its body.
paragraphs.zh: 具身智能体必须在相互竞争的身体需求之间进行优先级排序。 在主动推断中，它可以通过提高关于该需求的信息的精确度，或增加对能够缓解该需求的结果的偏好，来应对紧急需求。 我们在一个包含三种致命需求的觅食网格世界中，分别和联合比较了这两种干预措施，并探究了每种措施如何改变生存能力、感知以及智能体所学习的身体模型。 精确度会增强内感受性后验分布，并提高生存能力。 偏好重新加权能使身体状态远离其致命边界，并改变智能体从中学习的状态，因此其学到的模型覆盖的需求层级更少，所有层级的质量都较低，但在其访问的层级上质量略高。 在另外72种布局上进行的一项实验并未证实预测中的布局困难时的偏好优势，但两种干预措施都提高了这些布局中的平均生存能力，且它们之间存在正向交互作用。 因此，仅凭生存能力无法完整解释模型如何对需求进行优先级排序并学习其身体信息。

paragraphs.en: A multi-need embodied agent cannot service every drive at once. Hunger, thirst and the need to breathe can each demand a different action, and survival depends on which takes priority. The agent must also infer how urgent these needs are from its interoceptive signals. Active inference allows us to model this relationship between inference over bodily states and homeostatic control [ 22 , 2 , 23 , 1 ] . But responding to an urgent need can involve different mechanisms. We ask what difference the choice of mechanism makes to behaviour and learning.
paragraphs.zh: 一种多需求具身智能体无法同时满足所有需求。 饥饿、口渴和呼吸需求各自可能需要不同的行动，而生存取决于哪种需求被优先处理。 该智能体还必须通过其内感受性信号来推断这些需求的紧迫程度。 主动推理使我们能够模拟身体状态推断与稳态控制之间的关系 [ 22 , 2 , 23 , 1 ] 。 但应对紧急需求可能涉及不同的机制。 我们探讨选择不同机制会对行为和学习产生怎样的影响。

paragraphs.en: We compare two approaches to prioritising a bodily need. An agent that believes itself thirsty could increase the precision of its thirst signal, making information about thirst more reliable at the expense of other needs. Alternatively, it could increase its preference for water, so that policies leading to water become more attractive. The first approach is likelihood-precision routing , related to accounts of attention as precision-weighted sensory evidence [ 7 , 16 , 3 ] and to context-dependent likelihood precision in discrete-state visual attention [ 14 ] . The second is preference reweighting , drawing on motivational and homeostatic accounts of active inference [ 18 , 19 , 27 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 我们比较了两种优先处理身体需求的方法。 一个认为自己口渴的智能体可以提高其口渴信号的精确度，从而以牺牲其他需求为代价，使有关口渴的信息更加可靠。 另一种方法是提高其对水的偏好，从而使与水相关的策略更具吸引力。 第一种方法是可能性-精确度路由，这与将注意力视为经精确度加权的感官证据的理论 [7, 16, 3] 以及离散状态视觉注意力中的上下文依赖的可能性精确度 [14] 相关。 第二种方法是偏好重新加权，这借鉴了关于主动推断的动机和稳态理论 [18, 19, 27]。

paragraphs.en: These are not two implementations of a single mechanism. Both alter policy selection through expected free energy, but they need not change learning in the same way. Our precision intervention changes both the observations emitted by the body and the likelihood used for inference and planning. Preference reweighting changes which outcomes the agent seeks. Although preferences do not enter the likelihood update directly, the actions they favour change the agent’s experience and hence what it learns. Comparing the learned body model therefore tells us something that a survival comparison alone cannot.
paragraphs.zh: 这两种并非同一机制的两种实现。 两者都通过预期自由能改变策略选择，但它们不必以相同的方式改变学习过程。 我们的精确干预同时改变了身体发出的观测结果以及用于推理和规划的似然度。 偏好重新加权改变了智能体所追求的结果。 尽管偏好不会直接进入似然度更新，但它们所偏好的行动会改变智能体的经验，进而影响其学习的内容。 因此，比较所学到的身体模型能够揭示仅靠生存比较无法揭示的信息。

paragraphs.en: The choice also matters for biological interpretation. Precision points to gain control on interoceptive afferents [ 21 , 22 ] , while preference points to changes in regulated outcomes [ 25 , 18 ] . That the same behaviour can be produced by distinct underlying mechanisms is the familiar problem of degeneracy in biological systems [ 5 , 20 ] . A model that reproduces an animal’s behaviour does not fix which mechanism the animal uses.
paragraphs.zh: 这一选择在生物学解释中也具有重要意义。 精确性指向了对内感受传入神经的控制 [ 21 , 22 ]，而偏好性则指向受调控结果的改变 [ 25 , 18 ]。 相同的行为可能由不同的潜在机制产生，这是生物系统中常见的简并性问题 [ 5 , 20 ]。 一个能够再现动物行为的模型，并不能确定该动物具体使用了哪种机制。

paragraphs.en: We test each intervention separately and together in the same foraging agent. To our knowledge, these two ways of responding to interoceptive need have not previously been varied together in the same task while measuring their effects on the learned body model. We relate survival to posterior uncertainty, bodily regulation and the range of states represented in that model. We then test the most uncertain of these findings, the dependence of the preference effect on layout difficulty, on an independently selected set of layouts. The question is not only whether the agent survives, but how its way of prioritising needs changes what it perceives, does and learns.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在同一个觅食智能体中分别测试每种干预措施，也同时测试它们共同的作用。 据我们所知，这两种对内在感知需求的回应方式此前从未在同一任务中被同时变化，也未在测量它们对已学习身体模型的影响时进行联合研究。 我们将生存能力与后验不确定性、身体调节以及该模型所表示的状态范围联系起来。 接着，我们在一个独立选择的布局集合上测试这些发现中最不确定的一项：偏好效应是否依赖于布局难度。 问题不仅在于智能体能否存活，更在于它优先处理需求的方式如何改变其感知、行为和学习内容。

paragraphs.en: Smith et al. [ 24 ] dissociate interoceptive sensory precision from a bodily-state prior in a cardiac-perception task. We adopt the same strategy of varying distinct model parameters, here comparing likelihood precision with preferences. The distinction matters because a state prior expresses a belief about the body, whereas a preference specifies observations the agent wants .
paragraphs.zh: Smith 等人 [ 24 ] 在一项心脏感知任务中，将内感受性感觉的精确度与身体状态先验区分开来。 我们采用相同的策略，即改变不同的模型参数，此处比较似然精确度与偏好。 这种区分很重要，因为状态先验表达了关于身体的信念，而偏好则指定了智能体希望观察到的内容。

paragraphs.en: Precision-as-attention accounts describe attention through the precision of sensory evidence or prediction errors [ 7 , 16 , 3 ] . In a discrete-state visual-search model, context-dependent likelihood precision has been used to model selective attention [ 14 ] . The motivational and homeostatic literature encodes desirable bodily or contextual outcomes through prior preferences [ 18 , 19 , 27 ] . Related homeostatic reinforcement learning defines reward as reduced physiological deficit [ 12 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 精准度-注意力模型通过感官证据或预测错误的精准度来描述注意力 [ 7 , 16 , 3 ] 。 在一个离散状态的视觉搜索模型中，依赖上下文的似然精准度已被用于模拟选择性注意 [ 14 ] 。 动机与稳态相关文献通过先验偏好来编码期望的身体或情境结果 [ 18 , 19 , 27 ] 。 相关的稳态强化学习将奖励定义为生理缺陷的减少 [ 12 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Active inference also admits other ways to change behaviour. Hesp et al. [ 10 ] derive valence from the dynamics of policy precision, rather than the likelihood precision studied here. Other accounts couple preferences and attentional precision [ 19 , 17 ] . Our comparison makes the two interventions separately controllable within the discrete active-inference framework synthesised by Da Costa et al. [ 4 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 主动推断也允许通过其他方式改变行为。Hesp 等人 [ 10 ] 从策略精度的动态变化中推导出价值，而非本文研究的似然精度。 其他理论将偏好与注意力精度相结合 [ 19 , 17 ] 。 我们的比较使得这两种干预措施在 Da Costa 等人 [ 4 ] 综合的离散主动推断框架内能够被单独控制。

paragraphs.en: We study interoceptive prioritisation in a minimal model of embodied homeostatic regulation. A body has internal variables to maintain, an environment holds resources to replenish them, and an active-inference agent senses the body through interoception and acts to keep it alive. The body couples to the environment through the agent, so survival is a closed perception–action loop.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在一个最小化的具身稳态调节模型中研究内感受优先机制。 身体需要维持内部变量，环境则提供补充这些变量的资源，而主动推理智能体通过内感受感知身体状态，并采取行动使其存活。 身体通过智能体与环境耦合，因此生存是一个封闭的感知–行动循环。

paragraphs.en: The agent forages in AffectWorld , a 6 × 6 6\times 6 gridworld with hunger, thirst and oxygen. Hunger and thirst fall by one level per step. Eating restores hunger, while drinking restores one third of the thirst range. Water submerges the agent and lowers oxygen by two levels per step, whereas on land oxygen recovers by one level per step. Food and water tiles remain fixed and reusable, so the resource map does not deplete or change during these experiments. The agent dies when any need crosses its lethal boundary. Drinking can therefore relieve thirst while endangering oxygen, which places all three needs in tension (Fig. 1 ). 1 1 1 The model studied here has three interoceptive channels ( M = 3 M=3 ). It descends from our prior model [ 9 ] , which has four channels. The fourth, a sleep/fatigue channel, and its tiles are removed from the model rather than disabled.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体在 AffectWorld 中觅食，这是一个包含饥饿、口渴和氧气机制的 6×6 网格世界。 每走一步，饥饿和口渴程度各下降一个等级。 进食可恢复饥饿度，而饮水则能恢复三分之一的口渴范围。 水会将智能体淹没，并使氧气每步下降两个等级，而在陆地上，氧气每步会恢复一个等级。 食物和水格是固定且可重复使用的，因此在这些实验中资源地图不会消耗或改变。 当任何需求超过其致命阈值时，智能体就会死亡。 因此，饮水既能缓解口渴，又会危及氧气，这使得三种需求之间产生冲突（图 1）。1 1 1 本文研究的模型具有三个内感受通道（M = 3 M=3）。 该模型源自我们之前的模型 [9]，后者拥有四个通道。 第四个通道（睡眠/疲劳通道）及其对应的格已从模型中移除，而非被禁用。

paragraphs.en: We model the task as a discrete partially observable Markov decision process (POMDP) and use active inference to infer states and select actions [ 8 , 4 ] . The POMDP’s state factors are grid position, a context factor held fixed in these experiments, and the true level of each of the three needs. Position is observed exactly. The current tile’s resource cue is observed with 0.95 0.95 accuracy, and each need produces a noisy ordinal interoceptive observation. The agent therefore infers only the need levels. Actions combine a move with an optional interaction. Movement, body dynamics and the fixed resource map are given to the agent. Only the interoceptive observation likelihood is learned online.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将该任务建模为一个离散部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP），并利用主动推断来推断状态和选择动作 [ 8 , 4 ] 。 POMDP 的状态因子包括网格位置、在这些实验中保持固定的上下文因子，以及三种需求的真实水平。 位置可以被精确观察到。 当前格子的资源提示以 0.95 的准确率被观察到，而每种需求都会产生一个带有噪声的序数性内感受观察值。 因此，智能体仅推断需求水平。 动作由一次移动和一个可选的交互组成。 移动、身体动态和固定的资源地图均提供给智能体。 只有内感受观察的似然度是在线学习的。

paragraphs.en: Both interventions respond to the agent’s posterior estimates of need. Precision routing gives more reliable information about the need with the largest expected deficit. paragraphs.en: A scalar precision κ \kappa on the diagonal of the interoceptive likelihood A ( m ) A^{(m)} controls how reliably a true need level is reported. The same allocation changes the body’s emitted observations and the likelihood used for inference and planning. At higher κ \kappa the observation model places more mass on the correct ordinal level, and at lower κ \kappa it spreads that mass over the alternatives. Thus, when thirst is selected, the agent receives more reliable evidence about thirst and less reliable evidence about hunger and oxygen. Here κ \kappa is the diagonal probability mass of the likelihood, not an inverse-variance precision. The total precision across channels is fixed at K = M ⋅ κ ¯ K=M\cdot\bar{\kappa} , so prioritising one channel necessarily de-prioritises the others. Because κ \kappa scales A A , it affects state inference, policy evaluation and the Dirichlet update in Eq. ( 3 ). This is the precision-routing mechanism of our prior model [ 9 ] .

paragraphs.en: This intervention rewrites the raw resource preference scores C C from the posterior deficits and does not directly alter A A . Greater expected thirst makes water more desirable, and greater expected hunger does the same for food. If either deficit crosses the critical threshold, the alternative resource and empty tiles receive a large penalty. Because C C appears only in the pragmatic part of the policy score, this intervention changes action selection without entering the likelihood update in Eq. ( 3 ).

sents.en: Greater expected thirst makes water more desirable, and greater expected hunger does the same for food.
sents.zh: 预期口渴程度越高，水就越具有吸引力；预期饥饿程度越高，食物也是如此。

sents.en: If either deficit crosses the critical threshold, the alternative resource and empty tiles receive a large penalty.
sents.zh: 如果任一赤字超过临界阈值，替代资源和空瓷砖将受到较大的惩罚。

sents.en: Because C C appears only in the pragmatic part of the policy score, this intervention changes action selection without entering the likelihood update in Eq. ( 3 ).
sents.zh: 由于 C C 仅出现在策略得分的实用部分，这种干预方法会改变动作选择，而无需进入公式 (3) 中的似然更新过程。

paragraphs.en: Oxygen exposes an asymmetry between the interventions. It recovers passively on land and has no navigable resource cue, so preference reweighting does not target it directly. It can protect oxygen only by favouring policies that leave or avoid water. Precision routing can instead assign precision to the oxygen channel itself. The survival comparison therefore concerns the two interventions as implemented in a mixture of actionable and passive needs. It does not isolate their performance under symmetric access to every channel.
paragraphs.zh: 氧气揭示了这些干预措施之间的不对称性。 它在陆地上被动恢复，且没有可导航的资源提示，因此偏好重新加权不会直接针对它。 它只能通过优先选择那些离开或避免水的政策来保护氧气。 相反，精确路由可以将精确度分配给氧气通道本身。 因此，生存比较涉及在可行动需求与被动需求混合实施下的两种干预措施。 它并未孤立评估它们在对称访问所有通道时的表现。

paragraphs.en: Survival tells us whether prioritisation helps the agent stay alive. To understand how it does so, we also examine the agent’s uncertainty, bodily states and learned likelihood. In particular, preference can alter learning by changing the states the agent visits, even though it does not appear explicitly in Eq. ( 3 ). We distinguish the quality of the learned model across all need levels from its quality on visited levels, and measure the fraction of levels visited. This tests whether a lower overall score accompanies poorer learning on visited levels or narrower experience.
paragraphs.zh: 生存机制告诉我们，优先排序是否有助于智能体存活。 为了理解其作用机制，我们还研究了智能体的不确定性、身体状态以及已学习的概率。 具体而言，偏好可以通过改变智能体所访问的状态来影响学习过程，尽管它在公式（3）中并未显式出现。 我们区分了所有需求层级上所学模型的质量与仅在已访问层级上的质量，并测量了已访问层级的比例。 此举旨在检验：较低的总体得分是否伴随着已访问层级上更差的学习效果或更有限的经验范围。

paragraphs.en: The original experiment compares the four conditions on eleven distinct layouts with eight paired seeds. Each run comprises 20 learning episodes of 120 steps, and the learned-model comparison uses the same layouts and seeds over a longer run. These layouts were selected in an earlier task to distinguish controllers that respond differently to urgency, so we measured their difficulty in the present task from baseline survival rather than inheriting labels from that selection.
paragraphs.zh: 原始实验在十一种不同的布局上，使用八组配对的种子，对四种条件进行了比较。 每次运行包含 20 个学习阶段，每个阶段有 120 步；而学习模型之间的比较则在同一更长次数的运行中，使用相同的布局和种子。 这些布局是在一个早期任务中挑选出来的，用于区分对紧急程度反应不同的控制器，因此在本任务中，我们根据基线生存率来衡量它们的难度，而不是沿用该选择过程中的标签。

paragraphs.en: We also test whether the preference benefit depends on difficulty, as suggested by a post-hoc split of the original layouts. This experiment uses 72 additional layouts selected without inspecting intervention outcomes. Separate baseline runs assign them to three difficulty groups of 24, and evaluation uses eight new paired seeds. The primary test asks whether preference improves survival on the difficult layouts, averaging its effect with and without precision routing. The continuous relationship with difficulty and the effects across all 72 layouts are secondary analyses. The design and analysis were fixed before evaluation outcomes were inspected.
paragraphs.zh: 我们还检验了偏好收益是否依赖于难度，这是通过对原始布局进行事后划分得出的结论。 该实验使用了另外 72 个布局，这些布局是在未查看干预结果的情况下选择的。 独立的基线运行将它们分配到三个各含 24 个布局的难度组中，而评估则使用了八个新的配对种子。 主要检验旨在探究偏好是否能在困难布局上提升生存率，并计算其在使用与不使用精确路由时的平均效应。 与难度之间的连续关系以及所有 72 个布局中的影响属于次要分析。 实验设计与分析方法在查看评估结果之前就已经确定。

paragraphs.en: With the uniform baseline, the agent survives 0.56 0.56 of the episode, or about 67 of 120 steps. κ \kappa -routing raises survival to 0.83 0.83 , and the combined condition reaches 0.94 0.94 . Preference reweighting alone reaches 0.67 0.67 (Fig. 3 a and Table 1 ). The direction of the precision result agrees with our prior model [ 9 ] . Precision and the combined intervention improve survival after correction for multiple comparisons. The preference-alone estimate is less certain. Its interval includes both a decrease and an increase in survival, and an equivalence test is also inconclusive.
paragraphs.zh: 在统一基线条件下，智能体在回合中存活的比例为 0.56 0.56，即约 120 步中的 67 步。κ \kappa -路由将存活率提升至 0.83 0.83，而联合条件则达到 0.94 0.94。 仅通过偏好重新加权即可达到 0.67 0.67（图 3a 和表 1）。 精确度结果的方向与我们先前的模型 [9] 一致。 在修正多重比较后，精确度和联合干预措施均提升了存活率。 仅基于偏好的估计值不确定性更高。 其置信区间既包含存活率的下降，也包含上升，且等价性检验的结果也不确定。

paragraphs.en: In a post-hoc split of the original layouts, preference alone improved survival on the five where the baseline struggled and reduced it on the other six. We tested that possibility on the additional layouts, this time averaging the preference effect across both precision conditions rather than testing preference alone.
paragraphs.zh: 在对原始布局进行事后划分时，仅凭偏好就提升了五个基础模型表现不佳的布局中的生存率，而在另外六个布局中则降低了该指标。 这表明其益处可能取决于任务的难度。 我们在额外的布局上检验了这一可能性，这次将偏好效应在两种精确度条件下取平均值，而不是单独测试偏好效应。

paragraphs.en: The learned-model comparison reveals why it matters which states an agent visits. Preference reweighting lowers model quality when averaged over all need levels, yet slightly improves quality on the levels actually visited. It also visits fewer levels. Those it rarely visits remain close to the vague prior and lower the all-level average. In other words, the lower score accompanies narrower experience rather than poorer performance on the states encountered. Precision shows no comparable drop in all-level quality in the same learning runs.

paragraphs.en: The choice of prioritisation mechanism changes more than survival. Precision alters the evidence the agent receives and how it uses that evidence in inference and planning, while preference changes which outcomes the agent seeks. Both also change where the agent goes, and so what it later observes, believes and learns. On the additional layouts preference raised posterior entropy and precision slightly lowered headroom, so neither intervention is confined to perception or to action.
paragraphs.zh: 优先选择机制的选择所带来的变化比生存本身更为显著。 精确性会改变智能体接收到的证据，以及它在推理和规划中如何使用这些证据；而偏好则会改变智能体所追求的结果。 这两者都会影响智能体的行动方向，进而影响它后续的观察、信念和学习内容。 在额外的布局设置中，偏好略微提高了后验熵，而精确性则略微降低了可用空间，因此这两种干预措施都不仅限于感知或行动层面。

paragraphs.en: Why does preference change the learned likelihood when it never enters the learning rule? The answer is the agent’s experience. An agent that commits to relieving one need visits a narrower range of bodily states, and the levels it rarely visits stay close to the prior. It learns those states no less accurately, only less often. This is an interoceptive instance of the indirect coupling that Neacsu et al. [ 15 ] describe, and it is why an average over the whole likelihood says little about what the agent has learned from the states it actually encountered.
paragraphs.zh: 为什么偏好会改变学习到的似然度，即使它从未进入学习规则？ 答案是智能体的经验。 一个致力于满足某种需求的智能体所体验的身体状态范围会更窄，而它很少访问的状态水平则会保持接近先验值。 它对这些状态的学习准确性并未降低，只是频率较低。 这是 Neacsu 等人所描述的间接耦合在内感受层面的一个实例。 [ 15 ] 这也是为什么对整体似然度进行平均，并不能说明智能体从实际遇到的状态中学到了什么。

paragraphs.en: On the original layouts, preference helped where the baseline struggled and cost survival where the baseline already coped. Reweighting appears to overcommit the agent to one need, which is useful when the agent is failing and harmful when it is not. The additional layouts did not reproduce this pattern. Preference did not help on the layouts calibrated as difficult, no continuous relation with baseline survival was detected, and the unadjusted tertile contrasts run in the opposite direction, with the largest benefit on the easiest layouts. We therefore keep the overcommitment account for the original layouts only. What the additional layouts do show is that both interventions improve survival on average, and that the two together improve it by more than the sum of their separate effects. That is evidence of complementarity in survival, though not of how the two mechanisms combine.
paragraphs.zh: 在原始布局中，偏好机制在基线模型难以应对时提供了帮助，而在基线模型已经能够应对时则导致了生存率的下降。 重新加权似乎让智能体过度专注于某一需求；当智能体表现不佳时这很有用，但在其表现正常时却有害。 额外的布局并未重现这一模式。 在经校准为困难的布局中，偏好机制并未提供帮助，也未检测到与基线生存率之间的连续关系；而未调整的三分位对比则呈现出相反方向的趋势，其中最显著的益处出现在最容易的布局中。 因此，我们仅将过度专注的解释保留在原始布局的讨论中。 额外布局所显示的是：两种干预措施都能平均提升生存率，且两者结合后的效果优于各自单独效果之和。 这证明了生存率上的互补性，但并未说明这两种机制是如何结合的。

paragraphs.en: This matters for how active inference is used to model biological systems. Fitting behaviour does not tell us whether prioritisation works through interoceptive gain or through preferred outcomes, because both can produce the same survival. The internal measurements suggest what would. Uncertainty or gain, distance from physiological limits and the range of states experienced can all be measured alongside behaviour. We compare two implemented mechanisms rather than testing formal parameter identifiability, and the same ambiguity applies to homeostatic reinforcement learners [ 12 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 这一点对于主动推理如何被用于建模生物系统至关重要。 行为拟合无法告诉我们优先机制是通过内感受增益实现的，还是通过偏好结果实现的，因为两者都能产生相同的生存结果。 内部测量可以提示哪种机制会如此。 不确定性或增益、与生理极限的距离以及所经历的状态范围，都可以与行为一同进行测量。 我们比较的是两种已实施的机制，而非测试正式的参数可识别性，同样的模糊性也适用于稳态强化学习模型 [ 12 ] 。

paragraphs.en: The original experiment uses eleven selected layouts and its difficulty split is post hoc. The additional experiment separates calibration from evaluation but is still one task. Preference also has no direct target for oxygen, which recovers passively. A symmetric comparison would need actionable oxygen or preferences over body outcomes, and the joint hunger–thirst gate of the preference rule was never triggered in these runs.
paragraphs.zh: 原始实验使用了十一个选定的布局，其难度划分是事后确定的。 附加实验将校准与评估分开，但仍然属于单一任务。 偏好也没有针对氧气的直接目标，氧气会被动恢复。 要进行对称比较，就需要可操作的氧气或对身体结果的偏好，而这些运行中，偏好规则中的饥饿–口渴联合门控从未被触发。

paragraphs.en: Precision could also act on transition beliefs or on policy selection [ 13 ] . Varying emitted and believed noise separately would show which part of the present precision intervention carries its effect. More channels, richer environments and longer planning horizons would show how far the results extend beyond this gridworld and its three-step planner.

paragraphs.en: Likelihood precision and preference reweighting provide distinct mechanisms for interoceptive prioritisation, with different dominant effects on posterior uncertainty, bodily regulation and state coverage. The predicted preference benefit on independently calibrated difficult layouts was not established. Across all 72 layouts, the secondary analyses show positive average survival effects for both interventions and a positive interaction. Their internal observables reveal effects on later inference and learning that survival alone does not resolve. Comparing these observables is therefore important when using behavioural success to evaluate a model of prioritisation.
